items.detail: Commit 86de34b9 changes only .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl (`git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --name-only` -> that one file; 26 insertions/26 deletions). Python scan of every string field of all 333 parsed rows: (prompt|evidence)=/tmp -> before 20 hits on 17 complete rows, after 0 on complete/closed (only pending DOC-16 line 330 retains 3, out of scope). witness=live:scratch -> before 1 on a complete row (REVIEW-OB-015:247), after 0 on complete/closed (5 remaining are on pending DOC-16/DOC-19 rows). witness=commit: -> before 1 on a complete row (DF-OFF-BY-ONE-31:187), after 0 on complete/closed. `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/trace_marker_check.py .` -> 'trace-check: clean (.)' rc=0; on reconstructed before/after trees (/tmp/before, /tmp/after with docs/traceability-doctrine.md) violations drop 42 -> 30 and every one of the 30 remaining names a row whose evidence path is simply absent from the reconstructed tree (e.g. pruned .gitreins/history dirs) — none introduced by the change, and all 12 removed were on complete rows. Marker census unchanged: `grep -o 'ch:trace row=' | wc -l` -> 72 before / 72 after; recursive MARKER_RE census 61 markers/57 rows both sides. DOC-16 source files untouched: `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- internal/api/handlers_test.go pkg/api/metrics_spec_trace.go web/js/submit.js` -> 0 lines.

items.criterion: The repair changes only rows whose status is complete/closed (no pending/in_progress row's marker values are rewritten), and no row's status or key set changes.
items.detail: Row-by-row JSON compare of HEAD~1 vs HEAD: 26 changed rows, all status 'complete'; script output 'status changes: []' and 'key changes: []'; no changed row has a status other than complete/closed.

items.criterion: No marker is added or destroyed per row — each changed row keeps the same number of ch:trace markers, and every rewritten marker keeps its row= id matching the containing row.
items.detail: Per-row MARKER_RE census before/after produced no 'MARKER DELTA' lines; totals 61 markers/57 rows on both sides and `grep -o 'ch:trace row=' | wc -l` 72/72. The single row= mismatch (line 216 OB-GAP-093 marker reads row=OB-GAP-090) is byte-identical in HEAD~1 — pre-existing, not introduced by this change.

items.criterion: Every rewritten evidence/prompt/witness value is an honest, non-placeholder form (none:<stated reason> or a resolving repo-relative path), not a fabricated pointer to an artifact that does not exist.
items.detail: All rewritten values are none:<reason> forms (none:dead-tmp-brief, none:dead-tmp-battery-evidence, none:dead-tmp-harvest, none:dead-tmp-log, none:dead-tmp-evidence-dir, none:pruned-gitreins-history, none:pruned-gh-run-html-artifact, none:pruned-qa-evidence-dir, none:gh-cli-output-not-an-artifact, none:make-release-dry-run-not-an-artifact, none:dead-scratch-daemon-18711, none:dead-bunker-agent-d645e3ef) or a resolving repo path (DF-OFF-BY-ONE-31 evidence=internal/cron/memgate_test.go, which exists on disk). No bare 'none' placeholder emitted.

items.criterion: The commit= values the repair adds are the row's own landed commit (matching the row's commit_hash / worker_summary), not another row's sha.
items.detail: Line 209 INT-CI-004 had `commit=a9a91340` appended to its marker, but that row's commit_hash is null and its worker_summary says 'Verification-only close: exact-HEAD CI for a9a91340835c515fcb164dbd990c9c08713f973a is terminal' — a9a91340 is the commit whose CI was observed, not this row's landed commit. `git log -1 a9a91340` -> 'fix(board): verify deployed required_tools contract (DF-OFF-BY-ONE-39)', i.e. another row's commit. The repair manufactured a verdict=success -> commit binding that the row's own data contradicts, purely to silence trace_marker_check.py's R5 rule.

items.criterion: The repair does not leave the row's own prose contradicting the rewritten marker (e.g. prose still citing the dead /tmp path the marker now declares dead).
items.detail: Line 268 QA-OFF-BY-ONE-RELENG-2 foreman_note still reads 'EVIDENCE: /tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-releng2.jsonl (24 rows; launch OK agent=d645e3ef; collect OK rows=21; zero COLLECT-FAIL)' while the marker in the same field was rewritten to evidence=none:dead-tmp-battery-evidence — the row now simultaneously claims that /tmp file as its evidence and declares it dead.
